title: Best-Selling Manga of All Time
period_label: Latest announced figure · year on each card
source_line: Sources: publishers, Oricon, Mantan Web, ANN, other media, Wikipedia
scope_note: What counts: manga series ranked by the latest cumulative circulation announced by the publisher (or reported from its announcement), including overseas and digital editions where the announcement does. Figures that bundle non-manga books are left out (Crayon Shin-chan's 148M, Astro Boy's 100M). Totals only go up, so older figures are kept as minimums; each card shows the year the figure was first announced. Equal figures share a rank.

insights.text: Crayon Shin-chan's 148M is left out: it also counts ~20M non-manga books.
Next: seven series tied at the 100-million mark.
Jujutsu Kaisen added 50 million copies in the 15 months after its 2024 finale.
Demon Slayer has just 23 volumes: about 9.6M copies each, the most per volume here.
One Piece has sold about twice as many copies as any other manga.

items.name: One Piece
items.author: Eiichiro Oda

source.name: Oricon News

items.value_text_original: 全世界の累計発行部数が6億部を突破した（国内４億5000万部以上・海外1億5000万部以上）
items.notes: Announced by Shueisha with vol. 114 (on sale 2026-03-04; ANN posted the news 2026-03-03 US time). Same figure as Wikipedia. Previous milestone: 510M at vol. 103 (Aug 2022). No newer milestone found for vol. 115 (2026-07-03); vol. 116 reportedly 2026-12-04 (unconfirmed). Volumes = 115 as of 2026-11-03. Oricon says digital is not mentioned. Fact source: same Oricon/ANN articles.

source.name: Shogakukan ad media profile 'コミック作品プロフィールスペシャル ドラえもん' (PDF)

items.value_text_original: 紙版｢てんとう虫コミックス｣の累計発行部数は1億7000万部超、全世界で３億部超!! ※紙版＋デジタル版総計
items.notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same figure/source as Wikipedia (PDF Last-Modified 2024-08-13; as_of = upload date, the PDF itself is undated). No newer official figure found in 2025–2026 searches. Scope caveat: the 170M Tentomushi figure is much larger than the 88.2M reported for the 45 core volumes (2020), so the 300M likely counts all Doraemon comics lines (long stories, other editions, overseas) — confirm before saying 'the 45 volumes sold 300M'. Fact source: same Shogakukan PDF ('累計動員数は1億3500万人を突破').

items.name: Golgo 13
items.author: Takao Saito (Saito Production)
items.publisher: Leed Publishing (SP Comics); serialized by Shogakukan

source.name: Anime News Network (citing Shogakukan's Gunsmith Dave listing)

items.scope: franchise total, all formats (unspecified Japan/world, print/digital)
items.value_text_original: シリーズ累計3億冊超 (Shogakukan listing, per ANN: 'the overall Golgo 13 franchise has 300 million copies in circulation')
items.notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). No new figure since ~2021: Wikipedia cites Natalie 2021-03-25 (blocked HTTP 403, could not verify); the ANN 2022 piece cites Shogakukan's '3億冊超' for the whole franchise (compilations/spin-offs probably included). Later restatements with the same 300M: Nikkan Gendai 2025-06-19 ('単行本累計発行部数は3億部', 216 vols, https://www.nikkan-gendai.com/articles/view/book/373480) and Denfaminicogamer 2026-07-06 ('3億部を突破', 221 vols). Volumes = 221 as of 2026-07-06; may be 222+ by Nov 2026. Human decision: rank as 300M (tie with Doraemon) but note it is a round 'over' figure from 2021–22. Fact source: Ensky press release 2026-06-24 via https://kyodonewsprwire.jp/release/202606241349 ('以来一度も休載することなく現在も好評連載中') — the wording came from a search snippet; the fetched page confirmed the Guinness line ('単行本は2021年に200巻を越えギネス記録となる').

items.notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same as Wikipedia. Previous official milestone: Shogakukan 250M at vol. 100 (Oct 2021). items.name: Dragon Ball
items.author: Akira Toriyama

source.name: AFP via eNCA (attributing the figure to Shueisha)

items.value_text_original: The comics have sold more than 260 million copies in Japan and worldwide, according to publisher Shueisha.
items.notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same value as Wikipedia (which cites Toei 2022). AFP restated it in March 2024 (Toriyama's death), citing Shueisha; Japanese media say 約2億6000万部 too. No 2025–2026 update found. The 260M probably covers the original 42-volume run in all editions (incl. kanzenban); Dragon Ball Super not specified. A Wikipedia talk-page claim of ~350M is unsourced; ignore it. One-line fact is arithmetic: 260M / 42 volumes ≈ 6.2M per volume.
